mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notifications (receiver_id, sender_id, type, title, message, post_id, reservation_id, review_id) VALUES (#{receiverId}, #{senderId}, #{type}, #{title}, #{message}, #{postId}, #{reservationId}, #{reviewId})
mapper.select: SELECT notification_id AS notificationId, receiver_id AS receiverId, sender_id AS senderId, type, title, message, post_id AS postId, reservation_id AS reservationId, review_id AS reviewId, is_read AS isRead, created_at AS createdAt FROM notifications WHERE receiver_id = #{receiverId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, notification_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE notifications SET is_read = TRUE WHERE notification_id = #{notificationId}
UPDATE notifications SET is_read = TRUE WHERE receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND is_read = FALSE
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications WHERE receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND is_read = FALSE
